text: {"version":1,"kind":"analytics","reading":"Show revenue by store location over time (monthly) so the decline can be seen per location; \"region\" is read as the store location, and the causal \"why\" and investment recommendation are judgments the data can inform but not compute.","measures":[{"ref":"column:dev.orders.subtotal","aggregation":"sum","alias":"revenue"}],"groupBy":[{"ref":"column:dev.orders.location_id","role":"key"},{"ref":"column:dev.orders.ordered_at","role":"time","grain":"month"}],"display":["column:dev.locations.location_name"],"filters":[],"ordering":{"ref":"column:dev.orders.ordered_at","direction":"asc"},"expectedShape":"trend","unresolved":[{"clause":"revenue","options":["column:dev.orders.subtotal","column:dev.orders.order_total"],"material":true,"question":"Should revenue be the pretax order subtotal or the order total including tax?"},{"clause":"by region","options":["column:dev.orders.location_id"],"material":false,"question":"The project has no region; store location is used as the geographic breakdown."},{"clause":"why is revenue down / which region should we invest in","options":[],"material":false,"question":"The project holds no causal drivers or investment criteria; the monthly revenue trend per location is returned so the decline and relative performance can be judged."}],"provenance":{"column:dev.orders.subtotal":"q:revenue","column:dev.orders.location_id":"q:by region","column:dev.locations.location_name":"q:by region","column:dev.orders.ordered_at":"q:down"}}
